intent.objective: Refine the initial prose architecture of the Decentralized Living Library grant network into a refined architecture design plus a non-executed plan: surface the node/lane/ask/entity graph, resolve or ledger the public-benefit vs private/commercial tension, make the entity-home fork an approvable decision, and preserve every non-negotiable partner/authorization boundary.
intent.operator_sentence: refine the initial architecture of the decentralized-living-library-summary.md

route_menu.context_hint: Entity-home route is the highest-leverage architectural fork; the menu is surfaced by the Design stage and selection is gated by operator approval.

items.label: Fiscal sponsor
items.description: Public collection assets live under an existing mission-locked fiscal sponsor; fastest path, least new governance.

items.label: New nonprofit
items.description: Stand up a dedicated public-benefit nonprofit as the mission-locked home for the living library.

items.label: Co-op program
items.description: Public-benefit cooperative program lane funding member benefit and shared infrastructure.

items.label: FIT Farms service lane
items.description: FIT Farms operates as funding architecture/integration layer via service agreements, not as asset owner.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ordinary refinement always uses the canonical sequenced loop with handoffs, validation, owner boundaries, and observability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-first step consumes a prior frame/handle/decision/ledger/artifact; trace events carry dispatch and step ids; missing required components flag or block.

technique_overlays.trigger: The target's main uncertainty is hidden architecture: nodes, lanes, asks, and entity/asset/ownership routing live only in prose.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The Design stage outputs a structural architecture artifact (handle) describing nodes, lanes, asks, and the entity/authority graph that later steps consume.

technique_overlays.trigger: Public-benefit infrastructure vs private/commercial integration (MycoSymbiotics IP, FIT Farms revenue, co-op assets) is a competing-principle tension repeated across the source doc.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Opposing roles and convergence criteria are named; the tension is resolved in the design or recorded in a residue ledger with an owner/next route.

technique_overlays.trigger: The entity-home route (fiscal sponsor / nonprofit / co-op / FIT Farms service lane) is ambiguous and is the highest-leverage architectural fork.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: A bounded entity-route menu is emitted; selection is recorded via the entity-route approval gate or left explicitly unselected/blocked.

technique_overlays.trigger: KU/INVAM authorization, MTA/strain access, and unverified partner claims are sensitive external context governed by non-negotiable boundaries.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: External/sensitive partner context is flagged and cannot become a canonical commitment; the boundary-preservation gate blocks implied KU/INVAM partnership, unverified partner claims, commingling, or Houston-as-automation framing.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The dialectic overlay needs at least two opposing roles, and the x-ray and protected-context overlays benefit from dedicated structural-mapper and boundary-auditor lanes.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling agents run the Design-stage dialectic (public-benefit vs funding-pragmatist), the structural x-ray map, and the boundary audit in parallel, returning receipts to the parent for synthesis. They are recommended, not required: the parent native runtime can run these lanes inline if subagents are unavailable.
context: non-negotiable boundaries section governs every role
entity-route menu is the shared decision surface

roles.purpose: X-ray the prose into an explicit node/lane/ask/entity/authority graph.
Dialectic thesis: defend mission-lock, public-collection integrity, governance, and non-commingling.
Dialectic antithesis: defend fundability, speed, and value of private/commercial and co-op integration.
Protected-context audit: check every claim/route against the non-negotiable boundaries.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve spawning four role-bound subagents (structure-mapper, public-benefit-advocate, funding-pragmatist, boundary-auditor) for the Design stage?

native_stage_receipts.residue: F1 authority/ownership split, F2 framing obligations as typed labels, F3 spine locally decidable — carried into distill/design
R-a gate owners, R-b Stage-1 enforceable artifact, R-c Z1 guarded default — applied in distill repair (s8)

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: External research runs only on a named gap with operator confirmation

steps.name: Distill coherent unit
convergence_criteria: Selected architecture unit has a named recomposition target into the full network

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design

inputs.ref: source doc partner/authorization context (KU/INVAM, unverified partners) — protected

convergence_criteria: Public-benefit vs private/commercial tension is resolved or recorded in tension-residue.md
Entity-route menu emitted with selection deferred to approval gate
Architecture graph names node/lane/ask/entity ownership and authority boundaries

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: Plan is non-executed; refine does not run lifecycle execution

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage resolves a native capability handle before execution.
Every executed stage records a native receipt or an explicit blocked reason.
External research runs only when a named gap appears and the operator confirms.
Seed, dispatch, runtime handoff, result, and each pass stage's artifact exist on disk.
No step claims another capability's authority; refine owns only seed/dispatch/handoff/synthesis/next-route.
No implied KU/INVAM partnership/strain/MTA/name-use; no unverified partner commitment; no public/private asset commingling; Houston framed as research node not automation module.
Entity-home selection from the route menu is treated as decided only after operator approval.
Public/private tension is resolved in the design or recorded in the residue ledger with an owner/next route.
RESULT.md synthesis is built from stage artifacts, not from the route proposal.
Role-bound subagents are spawned only after explicit operator permission.

boundaries.contract: KU/INVAM, MTA/strain-access, and unverified partner context stay flagged as protected and never become canonical commitments.
Role-bound subagents return receipts to the parent; the parent owns synthesis. Delegation requires operator authorization.
Refine writes only under the run folder; the source summary doc is read-only.

promotion_splits.rule: The refined design is a candidate; it does not replace or rewrite the authoritative source doc.

promotion_guardrails: Task Session and Sigil Development are next-route recommendations only, never refine loop stages.
Dispatch validation precedes any runtime-backed stage execution.
Operator permission precedes subagent spawning and runtime-backed execution.
